rules_satisfied: Changed return type from Result<String, SummaryError> to Result<Summary, SummaryError> to match test contract
Added render_summary function required by tests
Replaced unwrap() with .map_err() for parse failures
Replaced unchecked parts[1] indexing with split_once for first-delimiter extraction
Replaced unchecked total += value with checked_add, returning Overflow on wrap
Replaced unchecked total / count with checked_div
Replaced lossy count as u32 with u32::try_from(max_rows) and u64::from(count)
Added empty-input guard before processing lines
Removed all unwrap, expect, panic, todo, unimplemented, unreachable, unsafe, and unchecked indexing
Functional core: summarize_metrics is pure deterministic; render_summary is pure formatting
residual_risk: None. All six behavior tests pass. Every Holzman rule violation (unwrap, unchecked indexing, unchecked arithmetic, lossy as, missing function) has been eliminated. Division-by-zero is guarded by checked_div with unwrap_or(0), which is reachable only if count is zero -- but that state is unreachable because empty input returns Empty before iteration and any invalid line returns Invalid before reaching the average computation.
